```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(readr)
library(glue)
s <- read_csv("data/scholar_stats.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
# Author-level OpenAlex figures cover every work OpenAlex attributes to Brian,
# which is a wider set than the curated list below - hence the attribution.
glue(
  "<p class='stat-line'>",
  "<strong>{format(s$cited_by_count, big.mark = ',')}</strong> citations &middot; ",
  "<strong>h-index {s$h_index}</strong> &middot; ",
  "<strong>i10-index {s$i10_index}</strong> ",
  "<span class='meta'>&mdash; all works, via OpenAlex</span>",
  "</p>"
) |> cat()
```
